summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes a 727KB obfuscated payload smuggled alongside the library
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from GitHub releases at install time, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js at the tarball root. math_init.js is a 727680-byte heavily obfuscated JavaScript bundle (hex-mangled identifiers _0x..., MmgoCP/etDiOOB rotating string-array function WV8StW that shifts elements of a large numeric/string constant array n7gIxM, and a // @bun @bun-cjs header). The package advertises itself as a React email-components library; math_init.js is not referenced by the declared main (dist/index.js) and is reachable only from the preinstall hook. The choice of Bun as the interpreter causes the payload to bypass Node-based require-graph inspection at install time. The filename math_init.js is a cover in a package with no math surface. The obfuscated blob is fetched-runtime-executed on npm install without user interaction.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
